thesis.name: Machine-Native Systems
thesis.statement: Reliable intelligent systems with explicit semantic boundaries, authority, execution state, and independently verifiable evidence.
thesis.scope: An engineering direction, not a scientific result. This public summary does not expose the private research repository.

focus.title: Separate decisions from authority
focus.text: Make the boundary between a proposed action, an admitted action and an observed result inspectable.

focus.title: Keep evidence independently readable
focus.text: Connect execution records to independent checks; study when learned decisions should abstain or escalate.

relationships.label: Shared design concern: admission authority is separate from proposed execution.
Research connection: what evidence is sufficient to accept a decision? No integration claimed.

ledger.text: Can execution evidence remain inspectable across an independent handoff?
Pinned source separates paper-risk admission from simulated eligibility and fills; tests not rerun here.
Four controlled mock probes and five route tests recorded on 13 September 2026; hardware excluded.
Two synthetic fixture outputs matched independent expectations at the frozen 25668c4 revision.
A cost or reliability advantage from selective specialist cascades is a hypothesis, not a portfolio result.

notes.title: TEMPER enters the public research map
notes.text: Pinned metrics source and unit tests inspected. Research scope added; no experiment rerun or performance claim.

notes.title: The evidence handoff becomes a two-file contract
notes.text: Recorded source review separates production-v2 capture from the independent reader and the older fixture oracle.

notes.title: Admission decisions become inspectable
notes.text: Recorded mock probes isolate switching economics, forced thermal lock and exhausted capacity.
